events.summary: Damascus, October 31 (QNA) - Israeli occupation soldiers arrested a Syrian citizen after conducting a foray into the fringes of Al-Hurriya village in the northern countryside of Quneitra, southern Syria, aboard five military vehicles. The Israeli troops then broke into multiple houses before withdrawing toward Al-Hamidiya Base. They also fired illumination flares over Breiqa village in the Quneitra countryside Saturday, amid continued drone flights over Daraa and Quneitra provinces.
